reason: Banyan Software is a permanent-hold acquirer with 100+ portfolio companies and an in-house 'AI-powered application modernization engine'; its postings (including an evergreen 'CTO / Engineering Leadership - Ongoing & Future Opportunities' talent-community req) show a continuous pipeline placing full-time CTOs/CPTOs into portfolio companies — it is far too large for a fractional CTO and is structurally the competing solution to post-acquisition engineering leadership gaps, not a buyer of one.
